goal: Add bounded public real-CS2-demo discovery, verified acquisition and safe extraction, prove real ticks and player states with demoparser2, then run the existing autonomous analysis and video workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A downloaded input is classified as a real demo only after demoparser2 parses non-zero ticks and player states; a downloaded file alone cannot pass.
Automated tests, one actual public real-demo download and parse, canonical evidence, and local_packager inspection pass with limitations recorded honestly.
Downloaded archives are HTTPS-only, size-bounded, hash-verified, and safely extracted without path traversal or unbounded member expansion.
Network discovery is explicit, bounded, rate-limited, and restricted to reviewed public catalogs or official credentialed platform APIs; it does not bypass authentication or scrape arbitrary sites.
The public catalog adapter dynamically enumerates current CS2 demo candidates and records repository, license, commit or object hash, download size, and expected content hash before acquisition.
The real demo runs through the existing analysis and evidence-video interfaces, and failed candidates automatically fall through to the next discovered source.

quality_metrics.method: candidate-scoring unit tests, bounded-discovery security tests, retry integration tests, real auto-test CLI execution, report inspection, and package inspection

quality_metrics.measure: genuine public CS2 demo discovery, provenance verification, safe acquisition, and parser proof
quality_metrics.target: one dynamically discovered public CS2 demo has verified HTTPS provenance and archive hash, safely extracts, produces non-zero real ticks and player states through demoparser2, and completes the existing analysis workflow without synthetic classification
quality_metrics.method: catalog contract tests, archive security tests, live catalog discovery, real download hash verification, demoparser2 integration, runtime artifact inspection, and canonical package inspection

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: A verified public real CS2 Demo was discovered, acquired, parsed, analyzed, and rendered without synthetic fallback; 79 tests collected, 78 passed, 1 environment skip; canonical media and package inspection passed.
The regression corpus is not cheat-labeled and the bounded parser omits shots, visibility, and information provenance, so detection accuracy remains uncalibrated.

worked: Hash-bound test, isolated runtime, browser, media, and package evidence all converged on one candidate source hash.
Separating catalog metadata discovery, verified cache acquisition, run-local staging, parser proof, and delivery evidence kept context bounded and interfaces reusable.
did_not_work: The first archive path guard treated Windows root-relative paths as safe until a focused test exposed it.
The first package attempt correctly failed because stale runtime and visual evidence were bound to the previous candidate hash.
experiments: Retain large reviewed archives in an external verified cache and stage only the selected input plus provenance into a candidate run.
